methodology.preprocessing: All transforms fitted inside a pipeline on the training split only and refitted within every CV fold - imputation, skew-based log transforms, encoding and scaling
methodology.sampling: Online Payment and Bank Account capped at 200K stratified rows to keep 5-fold cross-validation tractable; Credit Card uses all 284,807
methodology.imbalance_strategy: Single explicit strategy (class_weight), chosen by a four-arm ablation. SMOTE plus class weighting is a no-op, not a double correction: after SMOTE balances the classes the weights are exactly [1.0, 1.0]
methodology.missing_data: Bank Account encodes missing values as negative sentinels (prev_address_months_count is -1 in 71.9% of rows); these are mapped to NaN with an explicit was-missing indicator
methodology.hyperparameters: Random forest leaf size tuned by cross-validation on the training split (Credit Card selected min_samples_leaf=1)
methodology.cost_optimization: Threshold chosen by minimising Z = $100 x FN + $1 x FP, with the full cost surface published
methodology.uncertainty: Bootstrap confidence intervals on every metric; model comparisons use paired tests (McNemar, DeLong, paired bootstrap on average precision)
methodology.statistical_testing: 28 of 30 features significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction, but only 15 with a large effect size - at this sample size, rank by effect size rather than p-value
methodology.final_models: Bank Account Application Fraud: XGBoost @ 0.12, Credit Card Fraud: XGBoost @ 0.02, Online Payment Fraud: XGBoost @ 0.01
